## Why

Owner decision #45 owner.questions: a stopped slice lands in Needs you, the owner answers in ork, ork resumes the role. Today a stop shows only a status line and the answer is the CLI 'ork answer RUN TEXT'. Decided: #99 ui.answer-ui (a detail pane on the row, plus a Questions tab). Depends on S25.

## Files

- internal/tui: model.go (Enter on an engine row opens the pane, other rows keep switching project; pane state), keys.go (bindings, help), the pane view and its own small text field (a stdlib line editor: type, backspace, ctrl-u, left and right, paste through Bubble Tea's paste message; no Bubbles textinput, #111), view.go, overview.go, tests, goldens.
- internal/tui/live.go and daemon.go, internal/daemon/client.go: a typed Answer call beside Approve, Stop and Retry (S25).
- docs/dashboard.md (the pane), README.md if it describes the actions, docs/state.md or design.md only where they list the keys.
- The pane reads the pause kind from EngineRun.pending (#108) and the reason from EngineRun.Wait; no engine or wire change in this slice. No go.mod or go.sum change.

## Failing tests

- Enter on an engine run row opens a pane with the full reason and the actions that fit its state (#109); on a decision, question or ledger row Enter still switches to the row's project. Esc closes the pane.
- The pane reads the pause kind from EngineRun.pending (#108, added in S25).
- Paused with a question: the pane shows the question and a text field with the command ork answer RUN TEXT shown live; Enter in the field submits with no y/n; an empty answer is refused; the row updates after a call that worked.
- The text field handles typed text, backspace, ctrl-u, left and right, and pasted text; it needs no dependency and go.mod and go.sum are unchanged.
- Paused without a question: the pane shows the reason and offers retry (ork retry RUN, y/n as in S25).
- Stopped: the pane shows the full stop reason and no action (a stop is final; relaunch).
- A failed call shows its error code and message verbatim and clears its in-flight entry (test it).
- Runs started elsewhere (ledger rows) open no pane.
- No structured options in this slice (#104).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome; the help view lists the new keys.
